metadata.name: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes and ISO 4217 Currencies Reference
metadata.description: All 249 ISO 3166-1 countries and territories with alpha-2, alpha-3 and numeric codes, names, flags, UN M49 regions, currencies with start dates, calling codes, time zones, and EU and eurozone membership, plus every current ISO 4217 code with minor units, symbols, cash rounding, the decimals used by Stripe, Adyen, PayPal and JavaScript Intl, and currency changes since 2020.

conventions.codes_as_strings: Numeric codes are strings with leading zeros, for example 036 for Australia and 008 for ALL. Parsing them as numbers drops the zeros.
conventions.minor_units: ISO 4217 minor units: the number of decimal places. null means not applicable (funds, metals and special codes such as XAU and XDR). Payment APIs usually expect integer amounts in these units: 10.99 USD is 1099, 500 JPY is 500, 1.250 KWD is 1250.
conventions.cldr_digits: CLDR's display default, which differs from ISO for some currencies (for example HUF and IDR: ISO 2, CLDR 0). cash_digits and cash_rounding are for cash amounts, for example CHF rounds cash to 0.05.
conventions.intl_number_format_digits: What JavaScript's Intl.NumberFormat uses by default in the runtime named in sources. Other runtimes and versions can differ.
conventions.currencies_vs_iso_4217_currencies: countries[].currencies lists every currency CLDR records as legal tender now, with the date it started. countries[].iso_4217_currencies is the ISO 4217 List One assignment. They differ in a few places; see metadata.edge_cases.iso_and_cldr_disagree.
conventions.eurozone: eurozone is true for EU members whose current currency is EUR. CLDR 48.2's own EZ group has not yet added Croatia and Bulgaria.
conventions.gateways: Only values stated on each provider's page are included. adyen_decimals and paypal_decimals are null where the provider's page does not list the currency with a value.
conventions.regions: UN M49 regions as published in CLDR: region, then subregion, then intermediate_region where one exists. Antarctica (AQ) belongs to no M49 region, so its region fields are null.
conventions.names: English short names from CLDR, the names most user interfaces show (for example Türkiye, North Macedonia, Côte d’Ivoire). name_short is CLDR's shorter form where one exists, for example UK.

gateways.stripe_note: Charges may use two decimals, but payouts are zero-decimal: payout amounts must be divisible by 100.
Zero-decimal, but send as a two-decimal amount ending in 00: 500 charges 5 ISK. Fractions cannot be charged.
Charges may use two decimals, but payouts are zero-decimal: payout amounts must be divisible by 100.
Zero-decimal, but send as a two-decimal amount ending in 00: 500 charges 5 UGX. Invoices with fractional amounts are rounded to a multiple of 100.

user_assigned_codes.note: XK is not an ISO 3166-1 code. It is a user-assigned code used by the European Commission, CLDR and many payment providers. XKK and 983 are CLDR's user-assigned alpha-3 and numeric codes.
